title: What Adley Rutschman said about joining Red Sox after blockbuster trade
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adley Rutschman joined the Boston Red Sox in a trade involving Carlos Narvaez and three prospects from Baltimore.
Rutschman is recovering from wrist inflammation and has yet to debut at Fenway Park.
Boston Red Sox's interim manager, Chad Tracy, praised the acquisition, calling Rutschman a major upgrade for the team.

title: Lawsuit against Suffolk DA, BPD aims to force release of footage of fatal police shooting in Roxbury
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A nonprofit sued Boston Police and Suffolk DA to release footage of Stephenson King's fatal shooting in Roxbury.
BPD and the DA's office denied footage release, claiming it could jeopardize investigation and influence witnesses.
Officer Nicholas O'Malley, charged with manslaughter, shot King during a carjacking investigation in March.

title: Could Roman Anthony, Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox this season?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy provided injury updates on Garrett Crochet and Roman Anthony.
Garrett Crochet resumed light throwing activities after being sidelined for two months with shoulder and lat injuries.
Roman Anthony has progressed to batting practice, moving closer to a potential return to the lineup this season.

title: ‘We’ve got to make up for lost time’: After lengthy absence, Gabe Jacas faces a new challenge
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Gabe Jacas, drafted by the Patriots, missed early training due to prolonged contract negotiations and injury concerns.
Jacas has signed a 4-year, $8.6 million contract with an injury waiver for a knee issue.
Jacas's late start requires extra effort to catch up; his enthusiasm and energy impress coaches and teammates.

title: Skeletal remains found in South Boston home turn out to be animal bones, police say
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Police found animal bones at 8 Glover Court in South Boston during a response to a report on Monday.
The bones, initially investigated for human origin, were identified as animal by the state medical examiner's office.
Shoes in a bag were found near the bones; the case remains under active investigation by authorities.

title: Drake Maye, offense finish strong and other takeaways from Day 9 of Patriots training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Drake Maye ended Patriots' practice strong, completing 11 of 12 passes in the final session.
A.J. Brown was full participant in practice despite a dislocated thumb suffered earlier this week.
DeMario Douglas seeks a featured role, praised for versatility but facing inconsistent production history.

title: Family of Abington teen killed in crash during police chase says car was not stolen
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Sebastian Hamilton, 17, died in a crash during a police chase involving a reportedly stolen SUV in Abington.
The SUV belonged to a friend's parent; one teen took it without parental permission, according to Hamilton's family.
The pursuing officer is on leave as the crash, where four passengers were injured, is under investigation.

title: BC High adds former Patriots special teams ace Matthew Slater to football staff
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Matthew Slater has joined BC High's football coaching staff as Assistant Head Coach for Leadership and Player Development.
Slater played 16 seasons with the New England Patriots, earning ten Pro Bowl appearances and winning three Super Bowls.
BC High aims to improve their football program after finishing 4-7 last season, with Slater's guidance anticipated to be impactful.

title: Bill Murray makes surprise appearance at Bill Murray movie marathon in New Bedford
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Bill Murray made an unexpected appearance at a movie marathon dedicated to him in New Bedford on August 3, 2026.
The event, part of The Zeiterion’s marathon series, surprised 400 attendees when Murray joined the stage after 'What About Bob?'
Murray interacted with the audience for 12 minutes, sharing anecdotes and expressing his fondness for New Bedford and its events.

title: State Police trooper suspended after allegedly stealing Bobcat excavator
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: State Trooper Joseph Franklin faces two felony charges: larceny over $1,200 and witness intimidation.
Franklin's law enforcement certification was suspended following allegations of stealing a Bobcat excavator.
Franklin pleaded not guilty; arraignment was on July 17 in Palmer District Court, set to appear again this week.
